packageRules.description: Third-party GitHub Actions updates wait three days after release, then Renovate automerges them. The hive also merges Renovate PRs once the required checks pass, because mergeraptor is a trusted bot.
First-party projectbluefin/** actions merge right away and open at any time.
Renovate never automerges GitHub Actions majors. The hive's trusted-bot merge policy is independent of this setting.

gnomeos-boot-feasibility.yml are human-merge paths in the hive. Give their updates their own branches, so a pin-only update to them is a PR of its own that the hive's pin-only exception can merge, instead of being held with other workflows. Renovate doesn't merge these updates itself, because its own merge would skip the hive's hold on these files. The hive merges a pin-only update, and anything else, a major included, waits for a person.
